public_rationale: The June 2025 OMEGA study found worsening performance as mathematical problems became more complex, alongside some fine-tuning gains; these results do not prove that additional data must always leave consequential failures [e1]. An October 2023 study improved length generalization on tasks including parity and addition [e2]. A July 2026 revision reported representation interventions that improved accuracy on obfuscated tasks [e3]. These bounded improvements do not establish broadly reliable reasoning and planning on unfamiliar cases through increased training data alone, and none of the studies establishes permanent data insufficiency for the specified configurations [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The failure evidence covers tested models and mathematical task distributions, not every future data scale [e1].
The length-generalization improvements concern specific algorithmic tasks [e2].
The representation study examines extended thinking and interventions rather than isolating increased training data as the cause of broad reliability [e3].

evidence.explanation: OMEGA finds continuing failures on controlled mathematical generalization tests. Failures in tested models do not establish that every future amount of training data will be insufficient.
The study provides counterweight to a blanket inability-to-generalize interpretation. Its task-specific improvements do not establish broad reliability from data scaling alone.

The study examines transferable representations in obfuscated tasks and reports causal interventions affecting accuracy. Extended thinking and representation interventions do not isolate increased training data as the cause.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An applicable general result proving that increasing data alone necessarily leaves consequential generalization failures in the specified configurations would support the claim. An independently reproduced demonstration of broadly reliable reasoning and planning on genuinely unfamiliar cases, achieved through increased data alone while other relevant methods remain fixed, would contradict it.
